observations.vintage: first preliminary October Japan goods trade

executed_analysis.method: Exact 32 Bernoulli-state summation, Gaussian conditional density and CDF approximation; independently assumed 5 daily Gaussian innovations/equal weekly shock split; no fitted parameters; all probability updates are after observed closes.

judgments: The Thursday Nikkei increase (+0.71145%) coexists with a negative TOPIX (-0.04001%) and minority (40.12%) advancing Prime names; concentrated headline advance could misrepresent stock-level breadth. It is one as-of observation and has no validated predictive coefficient.

The October Japan goods import value growth (+21.6% YoY) coexists with import volume shrinkage (-0.2%); an arithmetic residual proxy of +21.84% combines currency, composition and goods price effects. No true causal or model calibration inference from this alone.

The 32-state post-Thursday conditional model risk at original sigma is ~77.61% for Nov13–20 Nikkei return <= -1.5%, compared with ~76.84% when latent weights not updated; reweight accounts for only ~0.78pp. This diagnostic uses realized market data and is excluded from Nov14 frozen forecast scoring.

hypotheses.next_test: Predeclare level and physical-quantity signals separately; evaluate against the same frozen no-change baseline over >=26 weeks, not on a retroactively chosen shock.
Predeclare breadth disagreement features and test 26-week forward realized volatility and tail risks against index-only proxy; no one-day winner selection.
Keep original Saturday three-arm predictions sealed, score only at publication and matched Friday close; conditional post-observation diagnostics remain separate.

limitations: October Japan trade was first released November 18; exact clock time not verified.
Arithmetic nominal/volume implicit values are not official deflators; commodity weights, composition and yen exchange rates matter.
Stock-breadth and top-contribution figures are secondary Kabutan reports; shares are of NET Nikkei gain and not gross total positive stock contributions.
Nikkei is price-weighted, TOPIX capitalization-weighted, Prime-wide issue breadth broader than Nikkei constituents.
Conditional probabilities use already-observed Monday-Thursday Nikkei closes, cannot count as Saturday-Nov14 prospective scores or evidence of model skill.
Independent Gaussian daily innovations and equal distributed event impacts are assumed, not calibrated; sigma choice materially changes outcomes.
US jobless claims and WEI and Friday endpoints were in the future as of cutoff; no scoring of them.
